gf256.description: GF(2^8) element (polynomial 0x11B) as two hex digits; canonical output is uppercase without prefix.

bn254.description: BN254 scalar field element as a canonical decimal string in [0, p); no sign, whitespace or leading zeros. The range check against p is done by the validators.

prime.description: Element of a prime field below 2^64 (model hades/prime/v1) as a canonical decimal string in [0, p); no sign, whitespace or leading zeros. The range check against p is done by the validators.

primeMatrix.description: A square matrix of width 3 or 4 over a prime field below 2^64; every row has the design's width.
